name: B10-0137/2026 (ECR) – Situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to fighting in Northeast Syria between the new Syrian government and the Kurdish-led forces. It wants the ceasefire agreed on 30 January 2026 to become permanent and properly monitored. It strongly condemns attacks on religious and ethnic groups, including Christians, Kurds, Druze and Alawites. It asks that EU money for Syria depend on protecting human rights and minorities. It also warns that escaped ISIS fighters, some holding EU citizenship, threaten Europe. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks all sides to respect the 30 January 2026 ceasefire and keep it permanent.
- It wants EU financial support for Syria tied to protecting human rights and minorities.
- It calls for EU countries to share information on escaped ISIS fighters with European citizenship.
